title: strace
description: Traces every syscall a process makes; -f follows forks and -c summarizes counts. It observes syscalls via ptrace syscall interception. Platform: Linux.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: ltrace
description: Like strace but for library calls, showing arguments to libc and shared-library functions. It observes library calls via breakpoint PLT interception. Platform: Linux.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: eBPF / bpftrace
description: Run sandboxed programs in the kernel to trace syscalls, network, and disks with near-zero overhead. It observes kernel + user events via eBPF programs on tracepoints. Platform: Linux 4.9+.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Frida
description: Inject JavaScript into running processes to hook functions on desktop and mobile without source. It observes function calls via dynamic code injection. Platform: Linux/macOS/Windows/Android/iOS.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: DynamoRIO
description: A runtime code-manipulation system powering tools like Dr. Memory with basic-block granularity. It observes instruction execution via dynamic binary translation. Platform: Linux, Windows.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Intel Pin
description: Pin instruments binaries at instruction level; the classic platform for custom analysis tools. It observes instructions via JIT-based instrumentation. Platform: Linux, Windows, macOS.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: DTrace
description: Sun’s dynamic tracing with the D language; probes fire on function entry, syscalls, and more. It observes kernel + app probes via in-kernel D-script probes. Platform: Solaris, macOS, BSD.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: SystemTap
description: Red Hat’s kernel instrumentation compiling scripts to kernel modules for deep tracing. It observes kernel events via kprobes/uprobes scripts. Platform: Linux.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: gdb breakpoints
description: The debugger’s breakpoints, watchpoints, and catchpoints are instrumentation for humans. It observes program state via ptrace breakpoints. Platform: Linux, macOS, BSD.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: rr reversible debugging
description: rr records execution deterministically so you can replay backwards — time-travel instrumentation. It observes full execution via deterministic record/replay. Platform: Linux x86_64.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: perf
description: Linux perf samples CPU, cache, and tracepoints with hardware counters at negligible overhead. It observes CPU + hardware events via PMU sampling. Platform: Linux.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Intel VTune
description: VTune’s hotspots and microarchitecture analysis find pipeline stalls in optimized code. It observes microarchitecture via PMU + instrumentation. Platform: Linux, Windows.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Valgrind
description: Memcheck, Helgrind, and cachegrind all ride Valgrind’s IR-based binary instrumentation. It observes memory + threads via IR translation. Platform: Linux.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: ptrace
description: The raw Linux API behind strace and gdb: PTRACE_SYSCALL, PEEKDATA, and friends. It observes process internals via kernel process-tracing API. Platform: Linux, BSD.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: uprobe
description: User-space static/dynamic probes letting eBPF attach to any userspace function entry. It observes userspace functions via eBPF uprobe attachment. Platform: Linux.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.
